title: One-Way Functions
description: Functions that are efficient to evaluate but computationally hard to invert on typical outputs. Hash preimage resistance and discrete-logarithm hardness are distinct examples of this shared cryptographic idea; neither problem is a prerequisite for the other.

resources.title: NIST: Cryptographic Hash Function
resources.notes: Defines the one-way property as preimage resistance and distinguishes it from collision resistance.

resources.title: Mastering Bitcoin: Public Key Cryptography
resources.notes: Explains easy forward evaluation and hard inversion for elliptic-curve public keys.
